legend: You are given a rearrangement of the string abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz. Call it s$$$s$$$. You can perform the following operation on s$$$s$$$ as many times as you want:

Sort any substring of s$$$s$$$ in increasing order. (Recall that a$$$a$$$ is a substring of b$$$b$$$ if a$$$a$$$ can be obtained by deleting some (possibly zero) characters from the beginning and end of b$$$b$$$.)
The string is called easy if you can delete some of the characters in s$$$s$$$ to make s$$$s$$$ equal to the string ezpc. Is it possible to make s$$$s$$$ easy after some (possibly zero) operations?
input: The input consists of multiple test cases. The first line contains an integer t$$$t$$$ (1≤t≤5000$$$1 \leq t \leq 5000$$$) — the number of test cases.
The only line of each test case consists of a single string s$$$s$$$ — the initial string. s$$$s$$$ is a rearrangement of the string abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz.
output: For each test case, output YES if it is possible to make s$$$s$$$ easy after some (possibly zero) operations. Otherwise, output NO.
note: In the first test case, s$$$s$$$ is already easy (so you don't need to perform any operations). You can delete the last 22$$$22$$$ characters of s$$$s$$$, and you will be left with the string ezpc.
In the second test case, you can make s$$$s$$$ easy with one operation: zaepcbdefgh... →$$$\rightarrow$$$ aezpbcdefgh....
Now, you can delete the first character, the fourth character, and the last 20$$$20$$$ characters in s$$$s$$$ to make the string ezpc: _ezp_c___.... Here the deleted letters are represented with _.
It can be shown that it is impossible to make the string in the third test case easy.

legend.ai: 给定字符串 abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz 的一个排列。将其记为 s$$$s$$$。你可以对 s$$$s$$$ 执行以下操作任意多次：

output.ai: 对于每个测试用例，如果经过若干次(可能为零次)操作后可以使 s$$$s$$$ 变得简单，则输出 YES。否则，输出 NO。

note.ai: 在第一个测试用例中，s$$$s$$$ 已经是简单的(因此无需执行任何操作)。你可以删除 s$$$s$$$ 最后的 22$$$22$$$ 个字符，剩下的字符串就是 ezpc。
